decisions.reason: The existing message-210 MODIFY already records conditional winner email notification and the associated email guidance; no update, removal, or scope change is missing.
The existing message-210 MODIFY already revises both reward FAQs to state that winners are emailed when an address was supplied and to include the required email guidance.
The existing message-210 MODIFY already records conditional email notification for prize winners and email guidance for viewing or converting the prize.
The existing message-210 MODIFY already updates the About-page reward-delivery copy with Winners-page posting, dashboard alerts, and email notification when an address was supplied.
Winner notification channels are owned by separate claim and notification Requirements and do not change the Small Block draw, ticket, eligibility, or funding mechanism.
The winner-email condition does not alter the landing-page hero copy or layout, and the source does not require that notification detail in the hero.
Conditional notification of prize winners does not change the referral code's source, permanence, or display locations.
The source revises prize-frequency and reward-access material but does not require winner-notification channels to be added to the Mission page.
The winner-email condition has no effect on the book cover's placement or headline integration.
Winner notification does not change the requested next-draw sales counter or its public-statistics scope.
The notification condition does not change founder, affiliate, or prize-pool allocations for primary sales.
Prize-winner email notification does not change the ebook reader's read-only mode, PDF.js implementation, or access points.
